name: patient_finding_of_body_mass_index_value_recorded_now_withunit_kg_per_m2
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's body mass index (BMI) in kg/m² recorded now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no BMI measurement is recorded now or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured BMI value in kg/m² if a BMI measurement is recorded for the patient now.

name: patient_has_finding_of_lipid_level_finding_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a clinical finding of abnormal blood lipid levels.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a clinical finding of abnormal blood lipid levels.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a clinical finding of abnormal blood lipid levels.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a clinical finding of abnormal blood lipid levels.

name: patient_has_finding_of_lipid_level_finding_now@@total_cholesterol_high
meaning: Indicates whether the patient's total cholesterol value is ≥ 200 mg/dL.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's total cholesterol measurement (mg/dL) recorded now is greater than or equal to 200.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's total cholesterol measurement (mg/dL) recorded now is less than 200.
when_unknown: Set to null if the total cholesterol measurement is not available or indeterminate.

name: patient_has_finding_of_lipid_level_finding_now@@ldl_cholesterol_high
meaning: Indicates whether the patient's LDL cholesterol value is ≥ 175 mg/dL.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's low density lipoprotein cholesterol measurement (mg/dL) recorded now is greater than or equal to 175.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's low density lipoprotein cholesterol measurement (mg/dL) recorded now is less than 175.
when_unknown: Set to null if the LDL cholesterol measurement is not available or indeterminate.

name: patient_has_finding_of_lipid_level_finding_now@@hdl_cholesterol_low
meaning: Indicates whether the patient's HDL cholesterol value is ≤ 50 mg/dL.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's high density lipoprotein cholesterol measurement (mg/dL) recorded now is less than or equal to 50.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's high density lipoprotein cholesterol measurement (mg/dL) recorded now is greater than 50.
when_unknown: Set to null if the HDL cholesterol measurement is not available or indeterminate.

name: patient_has_finding_of_lipid_level_finding_now@@triglycerides_in_range
meaning: Indicates whether the patient's triglyceride value is between 150 and 400 mg/dL (inclusive).
when_true: Set to true if the patient's triglyceride measurement (mg/dL) recorded now is greater than or equal to 150 and less than or equal to 400.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's triglyceride measurement (mg/dL) recorded now is outside the range 150–400.
when_unknown: Set to null if the triglyceride measurement is not available or indeterminate.

name: patient_sex_is_female_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient's sex is female at the current time.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's sex is documented as female at the current time.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's sex is documented as not female at the current time.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's sex at the current time is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.
